svg.title: Bec4096 framing of one body
svg.desc: Positions 29, 300, 301 and 4095 with external population 4. Block populations are 1, 2, thirteen zeros, then 1. Four split levels of the 4096-position tree recover them; only regions that are neither empty nor full store a field. The body is twelve head bits, one length-table bit (block 1), then the Bec256 streams of blocks 0, 1 and 15, 8, 15 and 8 bits, packed bit by bit, and four padding bits: six bytes db e2 54 11 07 0e. Binding decodes a directory of each block's population and stream start bit.

g.text: Bec4096: one headless body for sixteen blocks
blocks 2–14 empty: no stream, no length
length table: 1 bit, for block 1 (population 1 needs none; block 15's is never stored)
decoded once by bind_reader; every block access starts here
A dense random group: head 131 bits, length table 135 bits, sixteen streams of 297–323 bits; 652 bytes.
